verdict.rationale: Deel is a payroll platform, so cancelling or correcting a submitted payroll run before payout is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows that Deel runs payroll generally, plus API, sandbox, webhook and MCP material. Nothing documents cancelling, reverting or correcting a submitted payroll before employees are paid.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can cancel or correct a submitted payroll before employees are paid
